summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Brookfield Business Corp. reporting the results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 18, 2026. The filing discloses that all seven director nominees were elected by acclamation and the reappointment of Deloitte LLP as external auditor was approved. The voting structure involves Class A Subordinate Voting Shares and Class B Multiple Voting Shares. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event is described. The filing is a standard regulatory report of a routine shareholder meeting.
